column1: # Phase 5d reviewed zero-write contract for the browser read-only window step.
# contracts/legacy-web-v1/database-effects.tsv keeps ownership of the LOGIN and
# ROLE deltas the flow is allowed to create (AD_Session, AD_Preference,
# AD_RecentItem, AD_ChangeLog). This file adds only the window step's read-only
# assertion, which is a different claim: opening the "Error Message" window must
# The claim matters because the ZK 3.6 window is NOT dictionary-read-only.
# AD_Tab 314 carries IsReadOnly='N' and IsInsertRecord='Y', AD_Error is empty on
# a restored seed, and the window therefore renders an unsaved auto-new record
# with New Record and Save changes enabled. "Read-only" here is a property of
# the FLOW, and the only honest way to assert it is to measure that nothing was
# invoked once per capture at matching capture ordinals.

column4: The window's own table. The capture opens the window, reads it, and logs out without saving, so the unsaved auto-new record must never reach the database. A delta of 1 means the browser flow saved a record and the read-only claim is false.
Window construction reads the application dictionary. A write means the flow mutated the dictionary it was only supposed to render.
Tab construction reads AD_Tab 314. A write means the flow mutated the dictionary it was only supposed to render.
Field construction reads the tab's fields. A write means the flow mutated the dictionary it was only supposed to render.
